annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation binds vehicle manufacturers (or their accredited representatives), Approval Authorities and Technical Services, and Contracting Parties applying the Regulation.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to cybersecurity shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by their duly accredited representative.
annotation.dates_quote: Date of entry into force: 22 January 2021
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Regulation also applies to vehicles of the Categories L6 7 if equipped with automated driving functionalities from level 3 onwards
